message.quirky.totem_spawned: Your holding totem spawned in %s at (%s, %s, %s) — %s blocks from your spawn point
message.quirky.totem_spawned_cross: Your holding totem spawned in %s at (%s, %s, %s) — not in the same dimension as your spawn point
tooltip.quirky.seed_pouch: Right-click to plant 3×3; click in inventory to load/unload seeds (crops only)
tooltip.quirky.fish_bait: Throw into water to create a bait zone that makes nearby bobbers bite faster
text.autoconfig.quirky.title: Quirky Config
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitsToRetr: How many hits the holding totem needs before it drops its contents.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.spawnHeigh: How many blocks above the death point the holding totem spawns. 1 keeps it in reach; 2 raises it one block higher.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitSoundVo: Volume of the sound when the totem is hit. Values above 1 only extend the falloff distance; loudness is capped at 1.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitSoundPi: Pitch of the sound when the totem is hit.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.retrieveSo: Volume of the sound when the totem's contents are retrieved.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.enchantPar: 1 in N chance per tick to spawn a purple rune particle; higher values make particles rarer.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.endRodPart: 1 in N chance per tick to spawn a white light particle; higher values make particles rarer.
Horizontal spread radius (blocks) of the white light particles.
Vertical spread height (blocks) of the white light particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.particleXz: Horizontal spread radius (blocks) of the purple rune particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.particleYS: Vertical spread height (blocks) of the purple rune particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.modelScale: Display scale of the holding totem model.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.bobAmplitu: How far the totem floats up and down (blocks).
Floating period in ticks; higher values bob slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.spinPeriod: Rotation period in ticks; higher values spin slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.swayPeriod: Sway period in ticks; higher values sway slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.arrowDingV: Volume of the arrow hit ding (0.0-1.0). Kills play at 1.2x this volume.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.wakeUpSlow: Slow Falling duration after a full night's sleep; interrupted sleep grants a third of this.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.parrotEggH: Base chance (0.0-1.0) that a thrown parrot egg hatches; +0.25 when it lands on jungle leaves or logs.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.parrotEggT: Chance (0.0-1.0) that a successful hatch produces twins instead of one parrot.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.seedPouchR: Pouch planting area: 0 plants only the clicked block, 1 plants a 3×3 area, 2 plants a 5×5 area.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.fishBaitDu: How long a bait zone lasts in seconds; rain-boosted zones last 5/3× as long when the rain bonus is enabled.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.fishBaitRa: Radius (blocks) of the bait zone; bobbers inside it lure fish faster.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.tickerHold: How long the usage ticker stays visible.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.deathCamDu: Duration of the death pullback camera.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.quiverCapa: How many item groups the quiver can hold (1-8, default 4).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.petWhistle: How far (blocks) the whistle reaches pets to path toward you (8-64, default 24). Pets beyond this teleport to you.
Maximum number of phantoms taunted per whistle (1-5, default 3).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.ropeMaxExt: Maximum rope segments placed at once when sneak-right-clicking a rope.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.boomerangR: Maximum flight distance in blocks before the boomerang turns back.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.boomerangD: Damage dealt per hit to a living creature (0 makes it a pure pickup toy).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.boomerangB: Chance (0-1) that a solid block is shattered on impact; ignored for instant-break blocks.
tooltip.quirky.quiver.usage: Left-click ammo to load · Right-click to take out · Bows auto-draw from quiver
